newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Union Bank explains share plans.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Union Bank explains share plans.

text.p: Estonian Union Bank, one of the largest banks in the Baltic state, on Wednesday said it wanted to clarify to shareholders that it has no immediate plans to make an issue of new shares.
The bank, quoted in Helsinki and Tallinn, said earlier it would seek approval at a shareholders' meeting to issue 11.4 million preference shares.
But it said in a statement that for now it was only seeking the authorisation and an actual issue was not planned.
It said that once the board decides to issue the shares, the emission can be made at any time during the next five years.
